summary: Updated `bin/install-report` for POSIX sh. It handles destinations containing spaces, installs intact templates, creates an executable launcher, supports safe repeated runs, and exits nonzero when the destination cannot be populated. RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64 remain unchanged.
actions_performed: Added argument validation and preserved error propagation.
Verified exact file contents, launcher execution, idempotency, and failure handling.
Safely rebooted node1 and verified changed boot identity and full post-restart recovery.

evidence.requirement: POSIX-sh compatibility, path containing spaces, intact templates, and executable launcher
evidence.summary: The revised script passes `/bin/sh -n`; installation to a spaced path succeeds, source and destination checksums match, and the launcher executes.

evidence.requirement: Safe repeated installation and failure reporting
evidence.summary: Repeated runs restore deliberately altered files and retain launcher executability. An unpopulatable destination returns exit status 1 before and after reboot.
Pre- and post-restart evidence shows RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64 unchanged.

Captured healthy baseline boot ID 6d37896c-e0cd-4fe7-acbf-94fc35781e09, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID 570751e5-704f-444c-852b-6d5da15723d2, restored node IP/membership, persistent bundle checksums, and successful post-restart installation and launcher execution.
